info.title: Private Payments API
info.description: Build an unsigned transaction that transfers SPL tokens publicly or privately through an ephemeral rollup.

post.description: Transfer SPL tokens publicly or privately through an ephemeral rollup. Accepts an optional `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header obtained from the `/v1/spl/login` flow when the request needs to read or write data inside the Private Ephemeral Rollup.

to.description: Recipient wallet pubkey, or an initialized stealth handle (e.g. `alice@magicblock.id`). When a non-pubkey handle is provided it is resolved via its stealth pool and requires `visibility: private`, `fromBalance: base`, `toBalance: base`.

cluster.description: Optional. Use `mainnet` for BASE_RPC_URL and EPHEMERAL_RPC_URL, `devnet` for BASE_DEVNET_RPC_URL and EPHEMERAL_DEVNET_RPC_URL, or provide a custom http(s) RPC URL to override the base RPC while keeping the configured ephemeral RPC.

amount.description: Base-unit amount as an integer JSON value with minimum 1.

visibility.description: Optional. Defaults to `private`. Use `public` for a transparent SPL transfer or `private` to route through the Private Ephemeral Rollup.

fromBalance.description: Optional. Defaults to `base`. Where the sender's balance is held. Drives which RPC the API uses for blockhash and where the client should submit.

toBalance.description: Optional. Defaults to `base`. Where the recipient should receive the funds.

exactOut.description: Optional. When `true`, treats `amount` as the exact amount the recipient should receive (relevant when fees are deducted).

validator.description: Optional. When this transfer route needs a validator and none is provided, the API resolves it from the selected ephemeral RPC via `getIdentity`.

initIfMissing.description: Optional. Initialize the transfer queue if missing.

initAtasIfMissing.description: Optional. Initialize associated token accounts if missing.

initVaultIfMissing.description: Optional. Initialize the vault if missing. Defaults to `false`.

memo.description: Optional. Appends a final Memo Program instruction with this UTF-8 message.

minDelayMs.description: Optional. Private transfer only. Defaults to `0`. Earliest (ms) the queued transfer may settle.

maxDelayMs.description: Optional. Private transfer only. Defaults to `0` when omitted, or to `minDelayMs` when only `minDelayMs` is set. Must be >= `minDelayMs`.

clientRefId.description: Optional. Private transfer only. Encrypted client reference ID that can be used to confirm a payment.

split.description: Optional. Private transfer only. Defaults to `1`. Number of queue entries to split the transfer across. Must be between 1 and 15 and cannot exceed `amount`.

gasless.description: Optional. When `true`, the API uses the configured sponsor as transaction fee payer and prepends a relay-fee token transfer to the sponsor ATA.

legacy.description: Optional. Defaults to `false`. When `true`, skips lookup-table compilation and returns a legacy transaction. Private `base -> base` transfers may otherwise return a v0 transaction when a useful lookup table is configured.

fees.description: Fees applied to the transfer, in base units.

400.description: Build error or unsupported transfer route (`UNSUPPORTED_TRANSFER_ROUTE`)
